results.title: The PP, the PSOE and the ghost of prevarication with Ceuta
results.description: Everyone seems to be looking for a "solution" for Ceuta. A week ago, the Spanish government and the PP fully agreed on the idea of returning all immigrants who remained in the autonomous city. Also on prioritizing family reunification in the case of minors. The issue was that those who remained in Ceuta should also end up leaving. In fact, the trickle of returns has not stopped, police sources tell ARA, and some NGOs suspect that illegalities may have been committed among the first cases.

results.title: Bandra Road Rage: Fitness Trainer Arjun Garewal Refutes Assault Allegations; Claims Wife 'Scared' Of Going Out For Work After Incident
results.description: Fitness trainer Arjun Garewal has rejected claims made by accused Bilal Khan in the Bandra road-rage case, telling FPJ that new CCTV and dashcam footage supports his version. Garewal alleged the other vehicle jumped a signal, blocked his way and rammed his car. He said he carried a stick only for self-defence after men allegedly surrounded his vehicle near Bandra station.
